chunks: "Umrah to Umrah is an expiation for what is between them."

key_terms.إِلَى: to; indicating the span between two acts
key_terms.بَيْنَهُمَا: between the two; between one 'Umrah and the next
key_terms.كَفَّارَةُ: an expiation; that which wipes away sins
key_terms.مَا: that which; whatever falls within the mentioned period

ai.seo_question: How does one 'Umrah relate to another in terms of expiation?
ai.summary: This hadith states the great spiritual merit of performing 'Umrah repeatedly. One 'Umrah serves as an expiation for sins committed between it and the next, showing the purifying effect of worship and devotion.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Umrah to Umrah is an expiation for what occurs between them."
